_doc: Real-time combat rules for the skirmish demo. Every blow is melee, ranged or magic (units.json damage_type) and meets the target's defense against that type (units.json defense); against a building, wall, gate or tower a unit deals its building_damage instead of damage x role_matchups. Times in seconds, distances in world pixels (1 tile = 32). provoke_seconds: how long an idle unit or lair guard hunts the enemy that last hurt it, even one shooting from beyond its leash. fight_memory_seconds: a unit hit or striking within this time counts as in a fight, so a plain right-click moves it out (a retreat) instead of marching ready to fight.

dots._doc: Damage over time (abilities burn, bleed, frost; poison has its own entry above). burn: fire, fraction x the blow before defences, over seconds, cut by the target's magic defense; buildings burn too. bleed: fraction x the damage dealt, over seconds, through armour; the bloodless (undead, spirits, constructs, plants, buildings) don't bleed. frost: the target moves slow slower for seconds. A new dose keeps the stronger rate and restarts the clock.

veterans._doc: Veteran ranks, like the main game's (levels 1-5). A unit earns xp for the damage it deals and the hit points it heals, counted in its own hit points (100 damage dealt by a 100 hp unit = 1.0), plus kill_bonus x the victim's hit points for a kill. thresholds: xp for levels 1-5. Per level (index 0 = level 1): damage = more damage dealt, ward = less damage taken, hp = more hit points. At promote_level a base unit turns into its upgraded form (keeping its share of health); units trained already upgraded start at that level. Level 5 is the Ascendant form (its own art when the main game has it). Workers, heroes, summons and structures never rank up.

rest_heal._doc: Resting at home: a soldier (not a worker) that stands idle or on hold within radius px of its own capital and has not been hit for calm_seconds heals per_second of its health a second. Slow on purpose; the faction healing buildings are the fast way.

retreat._doc: Retreat (the foot on a unit card, or F): the units run to their capital (else the nearest settlement they hold) at speed_factor x their pace, and pick no fight and answer no blow until they get there.

upgrade_specials._doc: Specials of upgraded units (a dwelling's paid upgrade; see economy.json dwelling_upgrade). first_strike: blow on a foe at full health x factor. double_strike: a second blow or shot of factor x the first. life_drain: heals fraction of the damage dealt. armor_pierce: ignores this share of the target's armour. sunder: the target takes exposed more damage for seconds. fear: the target deals weak less damage for seconds. stun: chance a blow stuns for seconds (not heroes). cleave (melee) and splash: up to max_targets other foes within radius take factor x the blow. aura: allies within radius deal might more damage.
